text:
Anika: Heads-up: Acme wants us to prove cost wins without degrading core accuracy. We're running a split-test next week. Need final guardrails.
Ben: Quick proposal for pass/fail:
- econ: projected cost delta >= 15% vs baseline over sample traffic
- perf: p50 <= 110ms, p95 <= 320ms (p99 target is optional for aggressive batch)
- quality: indicator-task F1 drop <= 1.0% absolute OR human-rated quality delta <= 1 point on 5-pt scale
Rohit: For quantization presets: recommend two variants
- q8-fast: best throughput, expect ~18-25% cost reduction, measure model perplexity and task metric
- q4x-low: max cost saving but riskier, use only on non-critical routes and after eval approvals
Maya: Eval-alerts config idea:
- primary metric = "biz_label_accuracy"
- alert if drop >= 1.5% over 30m with at least 50 samples
- secondary: embedding_shift_mean > 0.02 over 1h -> warns
Anika: We need automated gating that can stop rollout. Conditions to block progression from canary -> broader rollout: any primary alert OR quality_drop > 1.0% OR econ < 10% projected.
Ben: Suggest we run two parallel canaries on Acme:
- route A: batch-hybrid + q8-fast (aim econ + low risk)
- route B: batch-max + q4x-low (max econ, higher risk)
Ben: Each canary should be 24-48h with matched traffic.
Rohit: Telemetry to collect: token counts, cache hits by prefix key, per-request batch delay, latency buckets, task metric, perplexity, sample prompts for manual review.
Maya: Also add a manual spot-check set: 200 seeded prompts from Acme to run as golden set once per config. Fail if >2% quality regression on golden set.
Anika: Ops constraints: batch windows >20ms are efficient but ruin p95. We should cap API-level max_batch_delay per route. For route A use 20ms, route B use 40ms.
OpsBot: scheduled deploy created -> canary/acme/split-test/2026-04-02 (status: scheduled) :calendar:
Maya: Rollback policy: automatic rollback to baseline if primary alert fires twice in 12h OR golden set fails. Also human-in-loop pause if embedding drift warns.
Ben: On caching: default to prefix cache for read-only queries; must get Acme-approved whitelist. Target cache hit >= 25% on routes we enable it.
Rohit: Add experiment tag to metrics so we can attribute cost and quality per variant.
Anika: Action items: @Rohit (add q8/q4x build + experiment tags), @Maya (eval-alerts config + golden set runner), @Ben (canary traffic split + cost projection), @Acme_CS (provide cache whitelist and golden prompts).
Maya: I'll open the PR for eval config and link the golden set.
Anika: Great. We'll review metrics 24h in. Thanks team. :rocket:
